violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. Box of oranges being stored over top of sink. Remove.
Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --A sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. -Need to wash, rinse and sanitize soiled dishes/utensils.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. -Was using cloths for handwashing. Need to use disposable towels.
Number, location, accessibility, soap and paper towels provided (3 pts deducted)
